correctness.rationale: Support maximization on the top chord and concave quadratic bottom yields a complete two-branch width formula for every parameter and direction. The derivative is the stated cubic over a strictly positive denominator. Its discriminant/factorization shows exactly one stationary birth. Envelope derivatives prove the two global threshold crossings unique, and exact resultants select their algebraic values. Third-order Taylor expansion plus uniform angular measure gives the 1/3 mass exponent, 2/3 density singularity and exact coefficient; a square-root-root expansion gives the 3/2 splitting law. Symbolic assertions and 50,331 independent diagnostics passed; numerical checks are supplementary rather than proofs.

value.rationale: The parameter a indexes all similarity shapes of perpendicular-chord parabolic segments, a classical natural family. The work resolves a complete geometric directional-width classification with two distinct optimizer switches, identifies a previously uncomputed interior density singularity at a fold, and gives the singularity and root-splitting constants. These are not a cosmetic restatement of classical area, perimeter or curvature facts; caliper-width distributions matter to direction-dependent strip containment and sensing.
